An account that ran out of quota comes back as Ready when its limit renews, instead of showing an error until a request happens to reach it.

## Fixes

- **A renewed limit is no longer an account error.** When an account's 5-hour or weekly limit ran out, its "subscription quota exhausted" message stayed after the limit renewed. The account went from used up straight to **Error**, and the "account error" notification went out at the moment it came back. The message only cleared once a request reached that account, which could take hours while its sessions were on other accounts. A message that explains a pause now ends with that pause, for spent quota and rate limits alike. Sign-in, permission and server errors stay until a request succeeds, as before.
- **The allowance shows up as soon as the provider reports it.** A usage reading with headroom ends a spent-quota pause and its message together, so a reset applied outside Fusebox, or limits the provider resets early, are picked up at the next check instead of waiting for the planned renewal.
- **Usage is read right after a renewal.** When a usage window renews or a quota pause ends, the next background round (within a minute) reads the account's usage instead of up to five minutes later, so the meters show the renewed limit straight away.
